tasks.name: threads-follower-count-of-an-account
tasks.title: Get the follower count of a Threads account
tasks.description: Followers, bio, verification badge and profile picture for one or more Threads accounts, without logging in.

tasks.name: threads-bio-links-and-contact-details
tasks.title: Extract bio links, emails and phones from Threads profiles
tasks.description: Pull the external link, email addresses and phone numbers that accounts put in their Threads bio — a contact list for outreach.

tasks.name: threads-profiles-in-bulk
tasks.title: Scrape many Threads profiles in one run
tasks.description: Feed a list of usernames and get one row per account with followers, bio, links and verification, ready for a spreadsheet.

tasks.name: threads-latest-posts-from-an-account
tasks.title: Get the latest posts from a Threads account
tasks.description: The most recent posts of an account with text, media, links, likes, replies and reposts.

tasks.name: threads-posts-with-engagement-metrics
tasks.title: Threads posts with likes, replies and reposts
tasks.description: Every post returned with its engagement counts, so you can rank an account's content by what actually worked.

tasks.name: monitor-competitor-accounts-on-threads
tasks.title: Monitor competitor accounts on Threads
tasks.description: Posts from a set of competitor accounts published after a chosen date — schedule it daily and you get only what is new.

tasks.name: threads-posts-containing-a-keyword
tasks.title: Find posts about a topic inside an account's feed
tasks.description: Scrape an account's posts and keep only the ones that mention your keywords — product launches, a campaign name, a city.

tasks.name: threads-profile-from-a-url
tasks.title: Scrape a Threads profile from its URL
tasks.description: Paste a threads.net profile link instead of a username and get the full account row back.

tasks.name: threads-images-and-videos-from-an-account
tasks.title: Download image and video links from a Threads account
tasks.description: Only the posts that carry media, with direct image and video URLs — useful for content archives and moodboards.
